title: OpenAI retires whisper-1, gpt-4o-transcribe, gpt-4o-mini-transcribe and gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize on 26 February 2027: what to change
description: On 26 February 2027, OpenAI removes whisper-1, gpt-4o-transcribe, gpt-4o-mini-transcribe and gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize from the API. The replacements, what else changes, how to find every use in your code, and how to test before you switch.
body_markdown:
On 26 February 2027, OpenAI removes whisper-1, gpt-4o-transcribe, gpt-4o-mini-transcribe and gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize from the API, together with its dated version. From that day, API calls to these models fail. OpenAI's recommended replacement (as of 14 November 2026): gpt-live-transcribe or gpt-transcribe.

## What retires, and what replaces it

OpenAI lists these models on its [deprecations page](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations). The dates and replacements on this page come from Driftline's registry, which is checked against that page several times a day, so they stay current if OpenAI changes them.

| Model | Replacement | Moving to it |
|---|---|---|
| [`whisper-1`](https://aidriftline.com/models/whisper-1/) | `gpt-live-transcribe` or `gpt-transcribe` | Pick one of two |
| [`gpt-4o-transcribe`](https://aidriftline.com/models/gpt-4o-transcribe/) | `gpt-live-transcribe` or `gpt-transcribe` | Pick one of two |
| [`gpt-4o-mini-transcribe`](https://aidriftline.com/models/gpt-4o-mini-transcribe/) | `gpt-live-transcribe` or `gpt-transcribe` | Pick one of two |
| [`gpt-4o-mini-transcribe-2025-12-15`](https://aidriftline.com/models/gpt-4o-mini-transcribe-2025-12-15/) | `gpt-live-transcribe` or `gpt-transcribe` | Pick one of two |
| [`gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize`](https://aidriftline.com/models/gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize/) | `gpt-live-transcribe` or `gpt-transcribe` | Pick one of two |

## More than a new model name

For these models, changing the name isn't the whole job:

- OpenAI names two replacements: gpt-transcribe for recorded files, gpt-live-transcribe for live audio. Word timestamps, subtitles and translation work differently, so check those if you use them. [OpenAI's guide](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/transcription)

## Find every place your code uses them

Run this in the root of your repository. No install, account or API key; it lists every OpenAI, Anthropic and Google model ID it finds, with file, line, retirement date and replacement:

```bash
npx -y @aidriftline/driftline .
```

A plain search works too:

```bash
grep -rnE '"(whisper-1|gpt-4o-transcribe|gpt-4o-mini-transcribe|gpt-4o-mini-transcribe-2025-12-15|gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize)"' .
```

It misses model names set outside the code: environment variables, deployment settings, values stored in a database, and defaults inside SDKs or agent frameworks you never configured.

## Test before 26 February 2027

Run a handful of real requests on the replacement and compare the results with what you get today, before the date. Check the parts your code depends on: output format, quality, length and timing.

## Get a reminder

The free [Driftline GitHub Action](https://aidriftline.com/#install) flags retired and soon-to-retire model IDs on every pull request, so the next retirement doesn't come as a surprise.

## Questions

### Will calls to whisper-1 keep working after 26 February 2027?

No. OpenAI removes the model from the API on that day, and requests to it return an error.
